Explain the differences between supervised and unsupervised learning in 5-8 sentences.

Supervised learning uses labeled data to train models for prediction. Unsupervised learning analyzes unlabeled data to discover patterns. Supervised learning aims to map inputs to outputs, while unsupervised learning seeks inherent structures.
